name: AiTrillion
description: AiTrillion connects your e-commerce store to Claude so you can ask about your own data in plain English — your loyalty program, earning rules and rewards, membership plans, product ratings, and store reports. The connection is strictly read-only: it can view and summarize your data but can never create, edit, or delete anything. You connect once and log in securely, and your data stays private to your store.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AiTrillion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AiTrillion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.aitrillion.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AiTrillion MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AiTrillion lists 37 MCP tools, including aitrillion_get_all_products_average_rating, aitrillion_get_customer, aitrillion_get_customer_activity_log, aitrillion_get_customer_fields, aitrillion_get_customer_loyalty_details, aitrillion_get_customer_membership_status, aitrillion_get_customer_unused_rewards, aitrillion_get_discount_detail, aitrillion_get_email_list, aitrillion_get_email_list_customers, aitrillion_get_loyalty_program, and aitrillion_get_membership_detail.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AiTrillion?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AiTrillion in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
AiTrillion requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AiTrillion is developed by AiTrillion. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
